Heavy rains impact India and China, causing disruptions and casualties

Heavy rainfall has led to disruptions in Mumbai, with a red alert issued and schools closed. Meanwhile, China is experiencing significant weather-related disasters, including flooding and casualties from Typhoon Maysak and other heavy rains. In India, increased rainfall has also boosted inflows into rivers and reservoirs.
